Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, street-facing, fov 75
- commercial arterial road, 4-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks present, curbs present
- driveways: north driveway apron, south driveway apron; parking: open asphalt apron surrounding pump islands
- gas station canopy building at center lot over pump islands, 1 story, steel frame, corrugated metal fascia, flat roof, 30 feet from road setback
- service station office building at rear right corner, 1 story, concrete block, brick veneer, flat parapet roof, at parking apron setback
- open service bay building at rear left corner, 1 story, concrete block, gabled metal roof, at parking apron setback
- utilities: overhead power lines on wooden poles, transformer on northeast corner pole
- landscape: flat asphalt apron, painted concrete curbing, narrow grass strip at road edge
- immutable elements: canopy with four corner support posts, pump island with eight dispensers, north and south driveway aprons
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1995
Clinton era prosperity. A 1995 self-serve station — wide canopy over multiple islands, attached convenience store, the first pay-at-pump card readers.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- automatic car wash bay at the back of the lot
- self-service only standard
- price sign showing gas around $1.15
- main sign: "Citgo" branded gas station — Citgo pole sign with price display and Citgo colors on the canopy fascia
- window signs: '32oz FOUNTAIN DRINK 89¢', 'CAR WASH $4 WITH FILL-UP'
- a hand-written 'PUMP 3 OUT OF ORDER' sign taped to one pump
- squeegee buckets at the pump islands
Typography: clean geometric sans-serif, early digital influence.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 5 people TOTAL: 2 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 2 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 1 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a family piling out of a minivan for a bathroom break
- a trucker stretching his legs beside his idling rig
- a grandmother pushing a wire cart of groceries
Clothing: men in grunge style, flannel shirts; women in crop tops, floral dresses. Fashion palette: forest green, maroon, mustard yellow. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes. Any customer activity at the pumps happens next to a parked vehicle — no one refuels without a car present.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 3 period vehicles, all different:
- 1992-1996 Ford F-150 — rounded aero body — navy blue
- 1988-1998 Chevrolet C/K 1500 — softly squared pickup — white
- 1993-1998 Jeep Grand Cherokee — early SUV, boxy-rounded — black
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 1995.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: the first two parked on the RIGHT side; the rest parked on the LEFT side. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, turn lane arrows
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, cable TV and early phone data lines on poles

TREES
- cottonwood tree at northeast corner of lot: clearly smaller than in the source — about 45% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- elm tree at sidewalk edge left of entrance: a young tree, only about 25% of its canopy in the source photo, thin trunk
- cedar tree at back fence line: clearly smaller than in the source — about 75% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodak Gold 200 or Fujifilm Superia 200 look.
Color: neutral to slightly warm tones. Grain: fine grain, cleaner than 1985.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1993-1998 Jeep Grand Cherokee — early SUV, boxy-rounded
